claims.text: Over the 14 days from the patch, the positive share was +6.2 points against the interrupted time series estimate of what it would have been without the patch (90% range -0.5 to +12.9). That isn't enough to credit the patch: its 90% range includes no change at all.
Positive share in the window was 82.68% across 791 reviews.
The baseline positive share was 78.2% across 1202 reviews.
There were 8 sale days recorded during the window.
Monetization negative mentions changed by -1.48 points in the window.
Off-topic negative mentions showed 0.0 change between the baseline and the window.
Players reported issues regarding game progression and mechanics in the reviews.
Composition change contributed 0.36 points to the overall sentiment shift.
New players accounted for 2.02% of reviews in the window compared to 2.08% in the baseline.

report.summary: Positive share in the window was 82.68% across 791 reviews compared to a baseline positive share of 78.2% across 1202 reviews. There were 8.0 reviews recorded as sale days during the window. Monetization negative mentions changed by minus 1.48 pp in the window, and off-topic negative mentions showed 0.0 pp change between the baseline and the window. Composition change contributed 0.36 pp to the overall sentiment shift. New players accounted for 2.02% of reviews in the window compared to 2.08% in the baseline. The patch and a sale and a review bomb are inconclusive, while a change in who reviewed and noise are rejected.
